text: Per the Dutch AFM register of substantial holdings, D. Kretinsky notified on 7 May 2026 a 29.64% capital interest and 29.64% of voting rights in PostNL N.V., held indirectly through EP Investment S.à r.l., EP Equity Investment Holding S.à r.l., EP Equity Investment S.à r.l. and VESA Equity Investment S.à r.l.
